help_intro: Every round has a letter. Fill in one word per category, all starting with that letter, and score points.
help_basics_1: The host creates the room and shares the code, the link or the QR. Everybody joins with a nickname, and the host starts the game once at least 2 players are in.
help_basics_2: In each round one player stops the spinning alphabet to choose the letter. Letters that were already used don't come back.
help_basics_3: Everybody gets the same categories, like Country, Animal or Name. The host picks them in the lobby.
help_playing_1: Write an answer in every field. A field turns green when the answer starts with the round's letter.
help_playing_2: When every field is filled in, the big Stop! button turns red and pulses. Tap it: everybody else gets 3 more seconds to finish.
help_playing_3: Not done but want to end the round? If the host allowed it, tap Stop! to ask everybody to stop. The others have 15 seconds to say yes.
help_playing_4: The host can also set a time limit for each round.
help_review_1: After the round everybody looks at the same category, one at a time. The host moves between them with the arrows and taps Finish review at the end.
help_review_2: Reject: tap it on an answer that shouldn't count. When more than half of the other players reject it, it is struck out and scores 0. You can't reject your own answer.
help_review_3: Same: tap it when two answers mean the same thing but are written differently (for example “NYC” and “New York City”). Then pick the first answer and the one that matches it.
help_review_4: Everybody votes Yes or No on that proposal, and whoever proposed it counts as a yes. If most players say yes, the answers count as the same.
help_review_5: If the host is signed in with Google, they can Ask the AI. It only gives a suggestion for each answer and never changes the points.
help_points_unique: A valid answer that nobody else has
help_points_shared: A valid answer that another player also has
help_points_end: Points add up round after round. A rejected answer doesn't count, so it never makes anyone else's answer shared. When the game ends, whoever has the most points wins.
help_tip_playing: Fill in every category with a word that starts with the letter. Once they are all green, tap the big Stop! button to end the round.
help_tip_review: Think an answer is wrong? Tap Reject. Two answers that mean the same? Tap Same, then pick them both.
